name: biceps curl front step
description: A rhythm drill pairing an arm curl with a quick step forward. Raises the heart rate while working the arms and legs.
instructions: Stand tall with your elbows at your sides and palms up.
Step one foot forward while curling your hands up to your shoulders.
Step back as you lower your arms.
Alternate legs at a brisk, steady pace.
Keep your elbows pinned and your core tight.
